sync.unpairBody: This phone and {{device}} stop syncing. Meetings already on each one stay where they are.
sync.unpairedBy: Unpaired by {{device}}. Pair again to keep syncing.
sync.wipeAsked: {{device}} asked this phone to delete the meetings they shared. They’ve been deleted here.

scan.cameraOff: The camera is off for {{app}}. Turn it on in Settings to scan the code.
scan.expired: That code has expired. Show a new one on your computer.
scan.notFound: Couldn’t find your computer. Check that both are on the same Wi-Fi.
scan.localNetwork: {{app}} needs the local network to find your computer. Turn it on in Settings.

sync.audioOnDeviceHint: Play it there. This phone has the notes and the transcript.
sync.refiningHint: The transcript can’t be edited until it comes back.
sync.deletedHere: Deleted here. It will be deleted on {{device}} the next time you sync.

error.unreachable: Couldn’t reach your computer. Check that both are on the same Wi-Fi.
error.refused: Can’t reach your computer. If you unpaired this phone there, unpair it here and pair again.
error.upgradeRequired: One of the two apps needs an update before they can sync.
error.storageFull: There isn’t enough storage space to finish syncing.
error.internal: Sync stopped because of a problem. Try again.

screen.localOnlyBody: Syncing stays on your Wi-Fi and never goes through the internet. Voice profiles stay on each device.
screen.off: Pair a computer to move meetings between this phone and {{app}} on your Mac or PC. Your computer shows the code under Settings → Sync.
screen.unpairAndWipeBody: {{device}} deletes the copies it got from this phone the next time they connect on the same Wi-Fi. Until then they stay there. This can’t be undone.
screen.wipePending: Waiting for {{device}} to delete the meetings it got from this phone. Keep both on the same Wi-Fi.
screen.wipeDone: {{device}} deleted them. This phone is unpaired.
screen.offlineFooter: A meeting you sent to your computer is processed on this phone after it has been away this long (on phones that can). Until then it waits.

hotspot.title: Can’t find your computer?
hotspot.body: Some Wi-Fi networks, like offices and guest networks, stop devices from seeing each other. Turn on Personal Hotspot on this iPhone, connect your computer to it, and scan again.
hotspot.export: Still not working? Your computer can export meetings to a file for another device.

lease.confirmBody: {{device}} stops refining this meeting and this phone takes over. The transcript can be edited again once it’s done.
lease.failed: Couldn’t take the job back. Try again.

conflict.label: Their version
conflict.failed: Couldn’t save your choice. Try again.

deleteAll.alsoHint: If {{device}} is reachable it deletes the meetings from this phone too. If it isn’t, it keeps them.
deleteAll.waitingBody: Keep both on the same Wi-Fi. Until {{device}} hears from this phone it keeps its copies.
